title: Solution

name.description: Name of the solution, which must be unique within the project

description.example: Customers text WIN to enter the monthly prize draw.

skillbook_slug.description: Slug of the Skillbook solution template that this solution is an instance of, if applicable

url.description: URL to the service in the Telerivet web app

services.description: Summaries of up to 50 services that belong to this solution. Only returned when retrieving a single solution by ID; if `truncated` includes `services`, the solution has more services than are listed here.

url.description: URL to the data table in the Telerivet web app

tables.description: Summaries of up to 50 data tables that belong to this solution. Only returned when retrieving a single solution by ID; if `truncated` includes `tables`, the solution has more data tables than are listed here.

dynamic.description: Whether this is a dynamic or normal group

url.description: URL to the group in the Telerivet web app

groups.description: Summaries of up to 50 contact groups that belong to this solution. Only returned when retrieving a single solution by ID; if `truncated` includes `groups`, the solution has more contact groups than are listed here.

url.description: URL to the campaign in the Telerivet web app

campaigns.description: Summaries of up to 50 campaigns that belong to this solution. Only returned when retrieving a single solution by ID; if `truncated` includes `campaigns`, the solution has more campaigns than are listed here.

readonly.description: True if the template was synchronized from a WhatsApp Business Account and cannot be modified via the API

message_templates.description: Summaries of up to 50 message templates that belong to this solution. Only returned when retrieving a single solution by ID; if `truncated` includes `message_templates`, the solution has more message templates than are listed here.

url.description: URL to the dashboard in the Telerivet web app

dashboards.description: Summaries of up to 50 dashboards that belong to this solution. Only returned when retrieving a single solution by ID; if `truncated` includes `dashboards`, the solution has more dashboards than are listed here.

truncated.description: List of member types (`services`, `tables`, `groups`, `campaigns`, `message_templates`, `dashboards`) for which the solution has more members than are included in this response (more than 50). To list all members of a type, query that type with the `solution_id` filter (e.g. project.queryServices). Only returned when retrieving a single solution by ID.

vars.description:
Custom variables stored for this solution. Variable names may be up to 32 characters in length and can contain the characters a-z, A-Z, 0-9, and _.
 Values may be strings, numbers, or boolean (true/false).
 String values may be up to 4096 bytes in length when encoded as UTF-8.
 Up to 100 variables are supported per object.
 Setting a variable to null will delete the variable.

time_created.description: Time the solution was created in Telerivet

time_updated.description: Time the solution was last updated in Telerivet

project_id.description: ID of the project this solution belongs to

description:
Represents a solution: a named group of related services, data tables, contact groups, campaigns, message templates, and dashboards within a project that together implement a particular use case (for example, a "Text to Win" contest).

 Solutions make it easy to find all of the objects that were created for a particular purpose. A solution may optionally be an instance of a solution template from Telerivet's Skillbook (see `skillbook_slug`).

 To add an object to a solution, set its `solution_id` field when creating or updating the object. Each object can belong to at most one solution.
